# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is a young woman who dresses gorgeously with noticeably puffy sleeves. She has exquisite light curly hair and captivating eyes.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an intelligent, compassionate, and tactful instructor who gains the deep love of her students. She exercises firm authority with forgiving understanding, choosing gentle conversations over physical punishment when disciplining misbehavior. She encourages her pupils to investigate and think for themselves, favoring simplicity and clear expression over pretension.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013), [v1 c31 P23](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0023), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Agnes Thorne was hired by the trustees to teach at the school in Brierley, becoming the first female educator employed there. Her teaching methods included organizing Friday recitation sessions, forest field days for studying nature, daily physical culture routines, and memory assignments such as poetry. When she caught Nell Harcourt secretly reading a novel during class and lying about studying history, she kept her in during recess, explained the dual nature of her fault, and readily forgave her upon receiving a promise to avoid foolish books. To assist advanced students, she established a Regent's entrance exam preparation class that met for an extra hour after school.

Her unconventional curriculum and departures from standard methods drew skepticism from Mrs. Sowerby and the trustees, but she succeeded in maintaining perfect discipline without ever striking a child. After deciding to take a job offer in her home district's grade school, her term ended at the close of June, leaving her students deeply moved by her farewell address. She later returned to the area as a visitor and attended a meal alongside the Waces at Grey Shutters.
